Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Patterson Lakes

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Patterson Lakes. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Patterson Lakes sits close to the water, so we know what salt air and wind do to metal roofs, flashings and gutters, and we recommend materials that stand up to it. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Patterson Lakes: What We Commonly See

Patterson Lakes is a distinctive waterfront estate, built around canals and lakes that run off Port Phillip Bay, with many homes backing onto the water. That position, surrounded by water and open to the bay, means salt and moisture are constants, corroding metal roofs, ridge capping fixings, valleys and gutters faster than on a dry inland block.

Most homes here are brick under COLORBOND® or other metal. The jobs we are called out for most in Patterson Lakes are rusted gutters and valleys, lifted and cracked ridge capping, and leaks where corroded flashings have failed on exposed waterfront homes.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Patterson Lakes

When a roof has reached the end of its life, replacing it is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof Patterson Lakes homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and well suited to bayside weather, and we use quality fixings, flashings and gutters that stand up to salt air.

If you are thinking about going metal, our tile to tin service is a popular way to lose the weight and the upkeep. If you are unsure whether you need a full re-roof, we will inspect the roof, show you what we find and give you an honest recommendation.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Patterson Lakes

Our registered roof plumbers look after the parts of the roof that take the most punishment near the water: flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes. Salt air eats through poorly finished metal quickly, so we trace leaks back to the real source and fix them properly rather than patching the ceiling stain.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Patterson Lakes

There is no standard price for a roof, because no two roofs are the same. The size and pitch of the roof, the profile and colour of the steel, the amount of guttering, flashings and downpipes, and the access to the site all affect the quote. We inspect the roof, put the price in writing and explain every line.

Our Patterson Lakes Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why Patterson Lakes Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

Patterson Lakes locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

Patterson Lakes Roofing FAQs

Does living near the bay affect my roof?

Yes. Salt air corrodes metal roofs, fixings, flashings and gutters faster than it does inland, so coastal homes benefit from quality COLORBOND® materials and regular checks.

How long does a re-roof take?

Most homes are completed in a few days, weather depending. We will give you a realistic timeframe with your quote.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
